biography.plain_text: Manuel António Couto Alves is a Portuguese construction entrepreneur, founder and chairman of Guimarães-based MCA Group. A third-generation member of a construction-business family, he spent twelve years as an ACA shareholder before launching MCA in 1998. He developed the new company from infrastructure contracting into an international platform spanning energy, urban development and health.

long_biography.plain_text:
MCA’s entry into Angola in 2006 turned the Guimarães contractor founded by Manuel António Couto Alves into an international project platform. Roads, bridges, water systems and electrical works supplied its operating base; renewable power and urban development extended the model across Iberia, Central Europe and Africa.

Couto Alves has alternated between executive leadership and oversight as the organisation matured. After two years as non-executive chairman, he resumed the executive chair in 2023. As ultimate beneficial owner, he chairs a board that delegates daily responsibility for energy and regional infrastructure to separate operating executives.

Couto Alves has alternated between executive leadership and oversight as the organisation matured. After two years as non-executive chairman, he resumed the executive chair in 2023. As ultimate beneficial owner, he chairs a board that delegates daily responsibility for energy and regional infrastructure to separate operating executives.
